Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2025
Post-pandemic era. A 2025 fuel stop — LED canopy, full-color digital price sign, and a convenience store selling fresh food.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- pay-at-pump screens with video ads
- drive-through coffee lane attached to the store
- price sign showing gas around $3.40
- main sign: "Citgo" branded gas station — Citgo pole sign with price display and Citgo colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'MEMBERS SAVE 10¢/GAL', 'HOT PIZZA SLICES $2.99'
- a kick scooter leaning by the store wall
- stacked delivery boxes by the store door
Typography: minimalist geometric sans-serif, heavily simplified flat logos.


SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'Citgo'
'MEMBERS SAVE 10¢/GAL'
'HOT PIZZA SLICES $2.99'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 7 people TOTAL: 3 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a clerk restocking the grab-and-go cooler behind the glass
- a teenager tapping a smartwatch to pay at the pump
- a teenager gliding by on a skateboard
Clothing: men in chunky sneakers, bucket hats; women in athleisure, chunky dad sneakers. Fashion palette: sage green, beige, cream. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 2022-2025 Honda Civic — clean mature compact — white
- 2023-2025 Honda Accord — clean minimalist refresh — black
- 2019-2025 Chevrolet Equinox — rounded compact crossover — dark green
- 2017-2025 Honda CR-V — rounded best-selling crossover — silver
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 2025 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 2025, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 2025.
Parked vehicles sit nose-in or angled into the lot, evenly spaced; none parallel-parked along the street, none blocking a driveway apron. Keep the driveway aprons and the drive lanes through the lot clear.
PLACEMENT: all parked in the lot, nose-in to marked stalls, with an empty stall between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, high-visibility crosswalks
- utilities: overhead lines on existing poles in older commercial areas, fiber optic widespread

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — smartphone or mirrorless camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: very clean, minimal to no noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
